name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship
sponsor: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)
eligible_institutions: Approximately 18 campuses have been selected through a competitive process to host fellows in group with thematic and subject affinities.
merit_criteria: Selected through a competitive process based on their potential for leadership and commitment to Public service in the public or private sector
other_conditions: Must be Pakistani citizens with 8-18 years of progressively responsible professional/work experience, coupled with 16 years of education (4 year Bachelor's or 2 year Bachelor's and a Master's degree) and a guarantee of re-employment upon return to Pakistan. University teachers or researchers with no management experience or similar responsibilities, those who attended graduate school in the U.S. in the last seven years or who have had long-term U.S. experience within the last five years, dual U.S./Pakistan nationality, or persons with a spouse, parent or child over the age of 18 who is a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, and employees of the Fulbright organization or the U.S. Department of State are ineligible.
benefits: The grant funds tuition, airfare, textbooks, a living stipend, and health insurance.
application_procedure: Online applications only. No paper applications will be accepted.
required_documents: Duolingo Test Score Report (or valid iBT TOEFL or IELTS test score), medical history and examination form, scanned copy of valid passport and No objection certificate (NOC) from employer / government of Pakistan (for finalists).
evidence_quote: Deadline May 20, 2026 ... The Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program brings accomplished mid-career professionals with demonstrated leadership potential to the United States for a year of graduate-level non-degree academic coursework and professional development activities.
